671.body:
<!-- release-scope:2026-11-16 -->

## Active 0.6.11 implementation scope — 2026-11-16

Parent #675; package **T2**, priority **P0**. Immutable novelty scope and observation time.
Canonical [owner-approved specification](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/blob/5e79664/docs/releases/0.6.11-workflow-patch-scope.md). The owner now authorizes implementation and **checks in GitHub Actions only**. No new paid model/qualification run, donor execution or local donor download. No default-branch merge, tag or release is implied. Existing findings, acceptance and original failures below remain in force; work is not marked complete by this update.

<!-- workflow-audit-2026-11-14:novelty -->

## Observed problem

Two investigations shared a mutable checkout. The Crab-assisted investigation analyzed a clean frozen receiving copy but later read a continuation fix written by the other investigation in the original checkout. It excluded the lead as `duplicate`, with `reviewed: true`. The decision cited old receiving lexical-mask lines; no exact pending ref/SHA was bound to that exclusion.

Avoiding a duplicate publication is correct. Retroactively treating a post-start external implementation as baseline presence, or erasing the original need, is not. This audit does not establish that the excluded lead was independently discovered.

The [decision validator](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/blob/9942f2f4715d2e58180eaac608390421930b28c2/src/hungry_crab/exploration.py#L316) and [read witnesses](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/blob/9942f2f4715d2e58180eaac608390421930b28c2/src/hungry_crab/inspection.py#L174) validate ranges/roles, not a typed pending-implementation basis for `duplicate`.

## Bounded correction

- Freeze selected/default/confirmed-pending identities and observation times with the receiving context.
- Bind a resolved already-present/duplicate exclusion to an actual immutable implementation and inspected relevant ranges, retaining its role and provenance.
- Treat later changes as later supersession/reconciliation. Preserve the initial observation, need, evidence and disposition history.
- Unknown/unacquired pending work remains unknown. Never implicitly fetch/switch/widen policy.
- Recheck current provider state before publication so preserved research history cannot authorize a duplicate effect.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A relevant existing confirmed pending implementation is linked as the actual exclusion basis.
- [ ] An unrelated old source range plus arbitrary duplicate prose cannot become verified pending equivalence.
- [ ] A controlled post-start concurrent fix cannot rewrite the frozen baseline or disappear from the record; publication reconciliation still prevents duplicate effects.
- [ ] Missing refs/changed bytes/out-of-scope work remain explicitly unresolved; legacy records are not silently upgraded.
- [ ] Multi-source occurrences and stable nutrient IDs survive; semantic equivalence remains analyst-owned.

Related: #532 and #554. Those own receiving context/pending reads; this is the newly reproduced exclusion-provenance and post-start timing slice.

This is an owner-requested planning issue from the 2026-11-14 fixed-pair audit. It authorizes no donor execution, paid campaign, merge or release. Preserve existing CLI determinism, source/license/origin guards, stable nutrient IDs and historical failed studies. #668/#669 fix the receiving Python miner; this issue fixes the workflow around that investigation.

The five audit issues are narrow follow-ups to #533/#532/#554/#488/#467 and the existing safety/reporting contracts, not replacement implementations of those capabilities. #668 belongs to #669; do not open a second implementation issue for it. ### W1/W5 — execution route and authority

Select and freeze the route before semantic work:

1. An ordinary explicitly supervised fixed pair reuses sniff/compare and bounded source, novelty and receiving-verification tools. It does not need repository discovery merely because the skill was invoked.
2. An explicitly metered/budget-qualified session preflights actual host capabilities before a lease/model operation. Unavailable or invalid metering refuses that route early.

Freeze the selected/default/confirmed-pending implementation scope and observation time before judgment. A resolved exclusion must retain its actual immutable basis and relevant inspected implementation, not only a reason string plus unrelated old lines.

It must neither become proof that the original baseline already had the behavior nor authorize publishing a duplicate now. Current provider reconciliation remains mandatory before effects. No implicit fetch/switch or global historical-absence requirement.

### W3 — verify the actual receiving behavior

The runtime contract must name the receiving consumer, expected/observed output predicates, ordinary valid control and correct fixture scope. Read receipts, helper calls, successful parsing and a lexical completeness Boolean are weaker facts.

For the exposed regression, successful masking must coexist with a failed graph/symbol assertion on the old receiver and a correct control. Preserve fixture/probe errors, including absent sampled output, without classifying them as product defects. Retain full original results/hashes when projections omit fields.

Acceptance design must state the supported subset, relevant scope/state distinctions, negative/unknown behavior, fallback, encoding and finite resource boundaries. This is receiving-specific, not a universal exhaustive-parser checklist. Design proposals keep an original receiving-bound acceptance artifact; they do not need an invented runtime failure. Reuse the existing original JSON cases, probe runner, required calls and case-results projection; no donor execution.

### W4 — evidence for requested independent review

Record whether independent review was requested and what was actually performed. An author recheck remains an author recheck, even after repeated tests.

When the host can run an authorized separate reviewer, retain its task/run identity, original evidence inputs, findings, corrections and final reviewed source identity. Missing capability, evidence or budget leaves that requested stage incomplete. Hashes and free-form “independent” labels alone do not prove independence.

Keep author checks, separately performed review, CI, publication and maintainer acceptance distinct. Do not start a model call, paid review or scheduler inside the CLI. Existing six-review qualification obligations are separate and unchanged.

### S1 — bounded literal matrix exclusions (#657)

The current default already reports modifier uncertainty honestly; #636 is not being reopened. The increment supplies an exact surviving count only for a clearly bounded supported subset.

Initial modified-matrix subset: at least one axis with a nonempty name and a literal list of unique strings (empty lists are allowed), no expressions or include modifier, and an exclusion list of literal nonempty dictionaries containing only known axis keys/string values. Admit at most eight axes and at most **256 Cartesian combinations**. For this modifier path, repeated axis values, unsupported value types/shapes, expressions, include combinations and products above the bound remain unknown with inspectable raw/count facts. Define these constants and diagnostics in the implementation before evaluation. Preserve existing no-modifier Cartesian behavior.

For admitted rows, match an exclusion's stated axis values and remove a matching Cartesian assignment once. Duplicate/nonmatching exclusions do not distort the count. Test full/partial exclusions, empty axes, no survivors, the ordinary no-modifier control and preserved fail_fast behavior. Preserve existing size/base_size/status/count fields and honest unknown behavior; no workflow execution, resolver or dependency.

This is a receiving-owned increment. The original donor record in #657 is not copied implementation or independent usefulness acceptance.

### S2 — executed local-fixture walkthrough (#278)

Use the existing tests/fixture_builder.py and existing fixtures; do not create a competing builder or modify history/scoring to obtain prettier output.

Preferred existing proposal: **docs/LOCAL_FIXTURE_MEAL.md**, linked from docs/COMMUNITY_START_HERE.md. The issue contains an existing volunteer claim and filename proposal; reconcile any actual contributor branch/PR before implementation, preserve credit and prefer completing/reviewing that contribution over a duplicate document. A claim alone is not evidence of implemented behavior.

Record an exact candidate revision, OS/Python/CLI versions, isolated temporary directories/cache, commands, exit codes, one actual nutrient/evidence and only a dry-run preview. The post-install walkthrough must not access GitHub, require publishing credentials, run fixture/prey programs or write outside its owned workspace. Use explicit local paths and --no-issues; keep receipt/ledger effects contained in the fixture maw. No private local paths or credentials in the published example.

Outputs are observations at the pinned revision, not generated examples labelled as executed. Any unavailable contributor work or unexpected network/write requirement remains explicit; do not hide a failure.

## Compatibility and safety boundaries

- Standard library + PyYAML runtime dependency policy, Python 3.11+, Windows and Linux.

- Preserve source, artifact, origin/licence and receipt integrity, no-donor-execution controls and all legal holds.
- Existing CLI, saved meals, exploration records and reports remain readable; new evidence does not retroactively certify old records.
- Keep side-effect admission and provider reconciliation fail-closed. Unknown costs are never zero and cannot pass a strict qualification cap.
- Keep the original tokenize-rt observations, first failed probes, initial continuation regression and review corrections as exposed regression evidence. They are not fresh discovery yield.
- No new universal syntax engine, tokenizer dependency, autonomous scheduler, fleet run, ranking retune or acquisition backend.
- Unrelated dirty benchmark/pair-host preparation files are outside this payload. Their presence does not authorize integration or a new comparative run.

## Implementation and integration order

1. Refresh master/open PRs, reserve an isolated receiving integration checkout, freeze all heads and reconcile #669 review/CI/native merge provenance.
2. Implement W1/W5 as a coherent route/authority change with early positive/negative admission tests.
3. Implement W2/W3 using existing immutable scopes and receiving case machinery. Keep historical/legacy status explicit.
4. Implement W4 delivery/reporting with actual supported host-review provenance; then verify one complete owned supervised route and one refused strict-metering route.
5. Complete S1 and reconcile/deliver S2, retaining their scoped checks.
6. Review the final integrated diff and docs/skill examples. Run the regular candidate checks on the exact final head; reconcile all open PRs again.
7. Prepare accurate changelog/implementation mapping and the separate release-readiness decision. No merge/tag/publish occurs merely because this plan was written.

## Required verification and closure

- [ ] Each selected issue has its original failing/unknown case, ordinary control and receiving-bound acceptance evidence; design-only/legacy/unknown cases remain correctly typed.
- [ ] Controlled duplicate/pending changes preserve role, time, original observations and publication reconciliation.
- [ ] Ordinary supervised unknown-cost work and strict metered refusal are both exercised end to end; a stopped controller cannot authorize a fallback.
- [ ] A requested independent-review stage is actually separately reviewed, or remains visibly incomplete.
- [ ] All currently open PRs have actual reviewed/check-verified integration or an explicit blocker. Closing an original contributor PR without its native merge is not the default integration route.
- [ ] Focused tests plus the repository's required Ruff check/format, strict mypy and pytest pass on the actual final candidate. Run CI on Linux/Windows and Python 3.11/3.14, including optional-MCP typing, minimum/base installation, bounded acquisition and installed-artifact checks.

- [ ] Executed walkthrough evidence and matrix subset/unknown limits match documentation and actual outputs.
- [ ] Record original requested/selected/completed/held work separately from CI, publication and default acceptance. Report actual known costs and omissions.

Close #668 only through the verified #669 integration and its remaining acceptance. Close #670–#674/#657/#278 only when their own scoped acceptance is met; do not close #540/#585/#532/#533/#488/#467 merely because this patch's mechanical checks pass.

## Release and comparative-acceptance boundary

The complete-cycle and comparative criteria in docs/releases/0.6.11-scope.md, #585 and #540 remain binding and unpassed. This plan adds a bounded technical candidate; it neither waives that release blocker nor starts its paid experiment. A later owner decision to publish a deliberately limited maintenance release must explicitly reconcile the pre-existing release scope before tagging, rather than silently treating these unit/control results as the full gate.

If release is subsequently authorized and all then-applicable gates are met, follow CONTRIBUTING.md: exact final candidate verification; the five version locations; actual uv lock regeneration; release/reopen commits preserved through rebase merge; exact release commit tag; green tag workflow; separately verified GitHub/PyPI/plugin publication. 677.title: fix: enforce discovery operation admission and live metering
677.body:
Strict discovery now requires a live bound host meter before session creation and authorizes every provider/model operation before dispatch. JSON declarations and semantic token counts cannot grant work or trusted completion.

## Result

- Freeze the session, attempt, operation, meter identity and shared allowances. Refuse unavailable capability, expiry, changed receiving context and orphan replay.
- Settle native usage and broker completion atomically before semantic recording. Pair every successful native begin with finish, including a None ticket; refresh time after preflight and recheck after native setup.
- Preserve original late charges, operation caps and stop reason/time. Reconcile legacy attributed usage once while keeping every unresolved or unattributed cost unknown.
- Reserve event and byte capacity for admitted operations' usage and terminal records. Unrelated accounting cannot consume that space; insufficient state capacity refuses new work before native setup.
- Route search, frontier and targeted issues through the broker. Require owned-fixture provenance for nonempty zero-request leads.
- Retain receiving, source, licence and publication guards. No production native meter is shipped; standalone strict initialization fails closed.

## Full review

The entire original `d6ba132` diff and the final correction candidate were inspected, including callers, recovery, fixtures, workflow and documentation. [Full report and evidence](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/blob/codex/review-open-prs-20261116/review/FULL-677-20261117.md).

Two additional **P1** defects were established: partial reconciliation could lose legacy unknown costs, and unrelated accounting could exhaust an in-flight operation's settlement capacity. [Original-head owned probes](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/actions/runs/44159053060) reproduced four failing assertions and one passing ordinary control in **each** supported environment. Both defects are fixed; eight permanent regression/control cases run in the focused and full suites. No remaining concrete technical finding was established in this author re-audit.

## Independent source review — 2026-11-17

At the owner's explicit request, a separate non-author agent (`/root/independent_review_677`, fresh context) independently reviewed **all 18 changed files**, relevant unchanged callers, the owner-amended T1 specification and original exact-head Actions evidence. It did not rely on the earlier author audit to establish findings.

**Verdict: APPROVE for this bounded PR; no actionable findings.** Reviewed head `e1466b3cd8951e8f433ef5a3d0a2a0a4940436e2` against base `9e7341986217fdca02a101d225ba4354bfe6480c`. [Original reviewer report and scope limits](https://github.com/drevendev/HungryCrab/blob/codex/review-open-prs-20261116/review/INDEPENDENT-677-20261117.md).

No implementation correction or new workflow run was required. This is the requested separate-agent source review, recorded with its provenance; it is not a GitHub account's formal APPROVED.
